name: IMREPO
description: Browse, manage and inspect OCI / Harbor container registries from a single workbench: project and namespace navigation, tag rename and delete, per-layer size analysis, Trivy CVE reports, registry-wide charts and multi-arch breakdowns.
releaseNotes: Private AWS ECR repository browsing with DescriptionRepositories and the AWS credential chain, image archive upload/download (.tar/.tar.gz), Docker Registry v2 projects, registry overview charts, and one badge per architecture. Repository moved to github.com/LeavingRain/dbx-plugin-imrepo. Security note: the last connection password / CLI secret is cached base64-encoded (encoding, not encryption) in credentials.json under the plugin data directory; prefer least-privilege robot accounts or read-only tokens and delete the file when no longer needed.
